correctness.rationale: All hypotheses and quantifiers stated. Algebra gives exact true residual ratio from the sketched normal equation. The Gram compression bound and its explicit eigenvalue-extremizing witness prove the sharp distortion coefficient. SPD polynomial bound proves the sharp angle factor; a two-eigenvalue example attains both simultaneously. At the critical threshold the sketched normal-equation numerator vanishes. A standalone exact-rational checker independently verifies Gram eigen conditions, the sharp residual witness and 2,500+ representative bounds; finite tests not used as infinite proof.

The exact critical sketch threshold also occurs in a different earlier spectral-sign result; the distinct sharp Euclidean residual law is the claimed additional content.
Bibliographic comparisons are bounded; no exhaustive uniqueness guarantee or independent audit.

value.rationale: A necessary-and-sufficient sketch-distortion safety frontier for true Euclidean residual decrease under one-vector restarting is a practical structural stability benchmark; generic quasi-optimality bounds do not certify the exact admissible range or reveal a perpetually stalled adversarial sketch at the boundary. The result is an exact all-condition-number classification on a natural algorithm, not a one-off arbitrary parameter computation, while extending no claims to longer restarts or random failure rates.
